module.name: Install Hugepages DaemonSet
module.description: Cloud-agnostic primitive: apply a hugepages-setup DaemonSet on BNK worker nodes (label role=bnk). Sets 2048 x 2Mi hugepages (4 GB) on each TMM node so kubelet advertises hugepages-2Mi capacity — required for F5 TMM to schedule. Matches awsbnkctl Phase 11b apply logic.

required.reason: Hugepages must be configured on BNK nodes before CNEInstance schedules TMM pods; Multus must be ready first so the node join is complete.

optional.name: install_hugepages
optional.description: Apply the hugepages-setup DaemonSet. Set false if hugepages are already configured on the cluster's BNK nodes.

optional.name: daemonset_rollout_timeout
optional.description: kubectl rollout status timeout for the hugepages-setup DaemonSet to be Ready. Default 300s matches awsbnkctl Phase 11b hugepagesReadyTimeout.

key_outputs.name: hugepages_installed
key_outputs.description: Whether the hugepages DaemonSet was applied by this module.

key_outputs.name: hugepages_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once the DaemonSet has rolled out on all role=bnk nodes. Downstream cneinstall/cneinstance modules depend on this.
